title: EIA U.S. Utility-Scale Battery Capacity in 2024
summary: EIA's preliminary generator inventory reports that U.S. utility-scale battery capacity increased 66 percent in 2024 and exceeded 26 GW.
key_findings: Operators added 10.4 GW of utility-scale battery capacity in 2024.
Battery storage represented about two percent of utility-scale generating capacity.
why_it_matters: This record advances grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance from upstream activity into a named operating, measurement, or explicit comparison-boundary record.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of eight Phase 55Z records for grid, water, storage, and minerals infrastructure performance.
Keeps unit, period, geography, and method attached to the reported result.
Identifies the next record needed before any cross-system comparison.
evidence_limits: Installed power capacity is not energy duration, availability, dispatch, revenue, or reliability effect.
The release uses preliminary generator inventory data.
